diagnostics.message: The subnet IAM grant targets service-agent principals configured by `service_agent_subnet_iam`, but it can be applied before the relevant project APIs are enabled. Add an ordering dependency so those identities can be provisioned before the grant.

This subnet IAM grant can be applied before the configured service identities have been created. The closely related project-level Shared VPC service-agent grant explicitly waits for these identities.

This subnet IAM grant may reference default service accounts before the module's default-service-account operation has completed; the corresponding project-level Shared VPC grant explicitly waits for that operation.
The subnet grant can be created before the BigQuery default service account lookup has completed. The matching project-level Shared VPC service-agent grant explicitly waits for this data source.
The subnet grant can be created before the Cloud Storage project service account lookup has completed. The matching project-level Shared VPC service-agent grant explicitly waits for this data source.

Associating this project as a Shared VPC service project requires the Compute API to be available, but this resource has no ordering edge to the module's managed API activations. If `compute.googleapis.com` is enabled here, wait for those activations first.
